raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 10
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly treated 1207 (the year Bishop Brice chose Spynie church as his cathedral) as a precise founding year for Spynie Palace. This conflates the cathedral designation with the palace’s founding. The HES source actually states the bishops may have established their residence at Spynie in the late 1100s and gives no exact founding year, with most credible sources describing the origin as “late 12th century” (around 1200).
